outcome: Prevalence of multimorbidities in children with moderate to severe allergic rhinitis (AR)
cohort: 600 children diagnosed with moderate-severe AR from the outpatient clinic of a single hospital
finding: Allergic rhinitis is accompanied by different allergic and non-allergic comorbidities, with age, familial history of allergy, allergen types, and cesarean section identified as risk factors for different multimorbidities.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was independently associated with an increased risk of AR and CRS (OR = 1.678, 95% CI: 1.100-2.561).
